notifications.title: YouTube raises the Partner Program bar on 1 Feb 2027: long-video watch hours are this channel's route
notifications.detail: YouTube announced (10 Aug 2026) that channels applying after 31 Jan 2027 need 1,000 subscribers plus 8,000 watch hours in 365 days (now 4,000), or a higher Shorts-views bar (outlets report 10M or 20M in 90 days; YouTube's own page will settle it). Existing partners are unaffected. Disaster Desk's 4 long videos have 0-16 views each and its Shorts 44-1,180, so it cannot reach the current bar before 31 Jan; the 8-10 min long videos are the realistic path (8,000 hours is about 55,000 full views of a 9-minute video). The 1 Oct Shorts 'original content' update targets re-uploads of other creators' videos; our promo Shorts are scripted and rendered fresh, so they are not affected as far as reported.
notifications.fix: 1. No action needed now. 2. When you review strategy, weigh how the long videos get found (titles, thumbnails, the promo Shorts' links) over Shorts volume. 3. Check YouTube's YPP help page in January for the final wording.
